verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop and mobile meeting-notes app, so the axis applies. The pack only documents an opt-out of model training (granola-docs-26, granola-docs-70). That is a related but different control: it covers whether your data trains models, not telemetry or usage tracking. The pack has no evidence of a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
